annotations.title: Fold Repetitive Build Logs with 100% Error Immunity

description: WHEN TO USE: Compresses verbose terminal, test, or build logs by folding repetitive middle progress lines while preserving head lines, compiler errors, stack traces, and file paths. DO NOT USE: When checking whether total prompt tokens cross a long-context surcharge threshold (use check_context_cliff). INPUTS & DEFAULTS: model defaults to 'openai/gpt-6.1-sol' (used to estimate input-token USD impact), raw_text defaults to '' (empty string returns zero-line payload cleanly). BEHAVIOR: Deterministic read-only text compression in memory; mutates no files or external state. OUTPUT: JSON with line_accounting_reconciliation, byte_and_token_reconciliation, and folded_context_payload.

model.description: Canonical model ID ('vendor/model-slug') used to price eliminated input tokens in USD.

raw_text.description: Raw terminal, test, or build log text to compress while preserving all error lines.

name: compress_and_fold_context
